en: Fixed sessions getting stuck endlessly retrying "unexpected tool\_use\_id" 400 errors: corrupted transcripts now self-heal where possible, and otherwise a clear error (with a `/rewind` hint) ends the loop
zh: 修复了 session 因不断重试“unexpected tool\_use\_id”400 错误而卡死的问题：损坏的对话记录现在会在可能时自行修复，否则会以明确的错误（附带 `/rewind` 提示）结束循环
